chunks.text: ORDER SHEET IN THE HIGH COUKT OF SINDH CIRCUIT COURT LARKANA Constt Petition No. S- 227 of 2D16 Date of hcaring Order With signature 0f Judge 20.02.2017, For orders on office objections For Katcha Peshi, Mr Muhammad Afzal Jagirani Advocate for respondent No,7, Mr Abid Hussain Qadri Slate Counsel Mr Gulshan R Advocate holding brief for Mr Riaz Ahmed 500110, Advocate for petitioner who is reported to be out of station However, petitioner is also called absent without intimation Mr, Jagirani Advocate for respondent No 7 submits that his client has not harassed petitioner nor would harass him in future Learned State Counsel while relying upon statement of respondent No states that the official respondents would act strictly in accordance with law and would not harass the petitioner as alleged The counsel holding brief after confronting with the above situation is satisfied and sceks disposal of the petition Order accordingly However the parties may avail Proper remedy from the relevant forum with regard their dispute over landed property Let copy of this order be sent/ faxed to respondents No1 and for compliance تتقس Dayo
